items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Oscar and Elon Watkins and I believe it was Thomas Ross, he's a trumpet player... was a very fine musician

ctx.x: They remembered, they remembered when the man told them who it was, because we were so terrific all along in those theatres and they said forget about it.
(Inaudible). No, you couldn't but I continued going out and had all those dances there; they had to pay them too, they were under the musicians, but after all it cost and everything.

Usually now one guy--but you need more than just one man, I think Oscar Estelle was in the band, that's why we did finally make it and talking about Tulsa, you take Spurgeon, Earl Bostic, came up through high school under William Jett and they would always find the little bandstand out of the military band; then my brother came--the one that I was telling you when I first came out of school in Sand Springs, he moved into Tulsa and was a band director of high school, and really, Clarence Little was one guy that…
